symbol.description: Ticker symbol in upper case, e.g. MSFT. From Alpha Vantage '01. symbol'.

price.description: Latest price as a decimal string, e.g. 383.45. From '05. price'.

open.description: Opening price for the trading day. From '02. open'.

high.description: Highest price for the trading day. From '03. high'.

low.description: Lowest price for the trading day. From '04. low'.

volume.description: Shares traded, digits only. From '06. volume'.

tradingDay.description: Trading date as YYYY-MM-DD. From '07. latest trading day'.

change.description: Price change versus previous close; can be negative. From '09. change'.

changePercent.description: Percent change including the % sign, e.g. 0.96%. From '10. change percent'.
